draft.notice: Shared by every ElevenLabs line in this language. Your edits go to a draft that calls never hear until you press Save to live.
draft.liveMoved: The live prompt changed after this draft started. Save to live replaces that newer text (it is kept as a version in the history).
draft.missing: There is no ElevenLabs prompt in this language yet.
draft.noChanges: The draft is the same as live.
draft.saveConfirm: Put the drafts live in both languages (NL and EN)? Calls use them within 30 seconds. The current live texts are kept as versions.
draft.saved: Saved to live. Calls use it within 30 seconds.
draft.savedNone: Nothing to save: the drafts are the same as live.
draft.saveFailed: Could not save to live. Try again.
draft.discardConfirm: Discard the draft in both languages (NL and EN)? Accepted suggestions go back to the list. Live stays as it is.
draft.discarded: Draft discarded in both languages. The editor shows live again.
draft.discardFailed: Could not discard the draft. Try again.
draft.syncFailed: The draft could not be saved first. Nothing changed. Try again.

versions.restoreConfirm: Put v{{v}} in the draft? Live does not change until you save to live.
versions.restored: v{{v}} is in the draft now. Live does not change until you save to live.

common.loadFailed: Could not load the prompt. Try again later.
